costa-rica.overview: Costa Rica has warm water and consistent waves for all levels. Beginners flock to the gentle beach breaks of Tamarindo, while intermediates enjoy Santa Teresa. Experts head south to Pavones for a legendary, long left-hand point break, or to Playa Hermosa for heavy beach break barrels. The Pacific coast works best from May to November on south swells.

months.1: Winter storms push swells and brutal weather onto the North Atlantic coast. Experts can surf sheltered beach breaks like Tjørnuvík, but conditions are unpredictable and the water is a freezing 43 F, needing a 6/5 mm hooded wetsuit with gloves and boots.

falklands.overview: The Falkland Islands offer raw, cold-water surfing for hardy, experienced surfers, mainly at Surf Bay near Stanley. Swell is consistent year-round, but brutal winds and freezing water make it for the dedicated. There are no surf schools or rentals, so bring all your own gear.
